svg.title: From Seller Mandate to Earned Commission
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-equipment-mandate-to-commission; chart type: process_flow; title: From Seller Mandate to Earned Commission; subtitle: Five documented handoffs keep equipment principal outside broker revenue.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The operator acts as a broker, not an inventory owner. Contract terms define commission entitlement, settlement instructions, inspection scope, and each party's responsibilities. Stage numbers indicate sequence rather than money or conversion.; caption: Use one transaction identifier across the mandate, serial-number evidence, lien work, buyer acceptance, and escrow statement. Recognize only the earned broker commission; never classify equipment purchase funds as operating revenue.; stages: label: Authorize the mandate; value: Verify seller identity, authority, asset, and commission terms; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Obtain a signed seller mandate naming the legal owner, machine serial number or VIN, asking price, commission formula, term, and authority to advertise. Independently verify the signer's authority before distributing inventory.; label: Build the evidence packet; value: Inspect condition and separate measurements from seller claims; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Collect service history, hour-meter evidence, ownership documents, and an independent inspection. For CNC assets, record controller version, spindle condition, tooling inclusions, power requirements, and loading constraints.; label: Resolve ownership and liens; value: Document creditor payoff and asset-specific release mechanics; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Search under the correct debtor identity and jurisdiction; check certificate-of-title records where applicable. Under UCC 9-315, a security interest can survive sale. Obtain secured-party authorization and the required release documents rather than treating a search result as clearance.; label: Match and contract the buyer; value: Confirm purchasing authority, acceptance terms, and funded capacity; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Use Airtable inventory fields and HubSpot buyer alerts to match capacity, location, budget, and timing. Document inspection acceptance, seller representations, rigging responsibility, delivery terms, and the commission trigger.; label: Settle and reconcile; value: Release funds against agreed evidence and book commissions only; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Use an independent escrow provider appropriate to the transaction. Verify changed wire instructions through a previously verified phone number. Reconcile buyer funds, creditor payoff, seller proceeds, broker commission, and delivery evidence to the signed settlement statement.
